statement:
by
  classical
  let S := fun {r s : ℕ} (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (β : DirichletCharacter ℂ s) (m : ℕ) =>
    ∑' q : ℕ, if hq : q ≠ 0 then
      let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
      if h : r ∣ q ∧ s ∣ q then
        let A := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.1 α
        let B := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.2 β
        gaussSum A ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum B ZMod.stdAddChar *
          gaussSum (A*B)⁻¹ (ZMod.stdAddChar.mulShift (-(m:ZMod q))) / (q.totient:ℂ)^2
      else 0
    else 0
  let O := S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  let P := (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  let B := Σ s : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ s
  let valid := fun b : B => b.1 ≠ 0 ∧ b.2.IsPrimitive
  exact ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → Even m → 2 ≤ (m-1).primeFactors.card → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ Y ≥ T, ∃ F : Finset B, (∀ b, b ∈ F ↔ valid b ∧ b.1 ≤ Y) ∧ ‖∑ b ∈ F, S P b.2 m‖ ≤ ε

plain_statement.zh: 若 m−1 至少有两个不同素因子，证明按导子高度截断的平凡行复数和趋零。
plain_statement.en: Two distinct prime factors of m−1 force signed principal-row cancellation in conductor-height order.

brief.zh: 按导子合并所有原始特征后，p|m−1 的局部带符号因子预期形如 1−p^(−s)。两个不同素数带来两次有限差分，有望同时消掉对数项和常数项。必须按高度 Y 的实际顺序估计余项；绝对值矩不能推出该结论。
brief.en: Summing primitive character values locally produces finite differences at primes dividing m−1. Two such differences should remove both logarithmic and constant terms. Justify the cutoff error in the stated summation order; an absolute row moment loses the cancellation.
